title: IT & Admin Officer
location: Herat - Herat with covering site offices
description:
Job Summary
Job Purpose
The IT Officer is responsible for ensuring secure, reliable, and effective ICT services across War Child Afghanistan operations. The role provides technical support, Microsoft 365 user administration, Windows Server management, infrastructure support, endpoint security, and vendor coordination while ensuring compliance with organizational ICT policies, security standards, and operational continuity. The position plays a key role in maintaining business-critical systems, supporting staff productivity, safeguarding organizational information assets, and enabling efficient day-to-day operations.
Job Description
The Duties and responsibilities may include but not limited to:
1. ICT Support & Operations
Provides first and second-line ICT support to staff in Herat and field offices.
Installs, configures, maintains, and troubleshoots computer hardware, software, operating systems, printers, scanners, and peripheral devices.
Resolves internet, email, network, and application-related issues to ensure uninterrupted operations.
Supports staff by providing troubleshooting, system guidance, and ICT-related training
Responds to ICT service requests and service tickets in a timely and professional manner
Maintains ICT equipment inventory and prepares regular ICT maintenance and service reports.
2. Microsoft 365 & Endpoint Management
Supports organizational email services and user lifecycle management, including user onboarding and offboarding, access management, password resets, and authentication support
Assists users with Microsoft Office applications, email systems, and collaboration tools.
Maintains standardized and updated workstation configurations across all offices.
Ensures compliance with authorized software standards by implementing and monitoring approved software installation policies on user devices.
Ensures compliance with ICT standards and user access controls across organizational systems.
3. Infrastructure, Servers & Security
Administers and maintains LAN, WAN, and VPN infrastructure to support office operations, connectivity, and secure remote access.
Monitors and maintains computer systems, networks, and related ICT infrastructure across country offices.
Manages the setup, configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of network security appliances, including firewall policies, VPN connectivity, and security controls
Provides wireless network support and maintains network reliability for staff and guests
Supports data integrity, information security, and secure ICT operations.
Conducts inspections, testing, and maintenance of ICT equipment and infrastructure.
· Conducts regular cybersecurity awareness and risk management training across the country programme to promote secure practices and strengthen information security compliance.
4. Vendor, Partner & Technical Coordination
Provides technical advice on ICT equipment specifications, procurement, and technology selection
Coordinates maintenance and replacement of ICT equipment and technology assets
Liaises with service providers and external technical support when required to maintain operational continuity.
Supports field offices through technical visits, troubleshooting, and implementation of ICT solutions.
Key Achievements and Technical Competencies
Manages organization-wide ICT support services across main and field offices.
Maintains secure and updated computing environments through antivirus deployment, software updates, and system standardization
Manages ICT asset inventory, maintenance records, and equipment lifecycle support.
Delivers network, internet, wireless, printer, scanner, and end-user support services.
Supports data backup, recovery preparedness, and information security initiatives.
Administration & Office Maintenance
Maintains and updates the organizational asset register, ensuring accurate recording of asset additions, transfers, disposals, and changes.
Ensures all organizational assets were properly tagged, recorded, and tracked in accordance with asset management procedures.
Assists in conducting periodic physical asset verification and inventory audits.
Conducts monthly stock checks of office supplies and consumables and reports findings to management.
Coordinates routine office maintenance activities to ensure a safe, functional, and well-maintained working environment.
Monitors the efficient use and safeguarding of office resources and organizational assets.
Supports IT related procurement processes through preparation of specifications, inspections, and verification of newly purchased equipment and supplies.
Maintains inventory records and condition reports for office equipment and assets across offices.
Prepares periodic asset management, inventory, and administrative reports for management review and decision-making.
Supports compliance with organizational procedures relating to asset management, office administration, and resource utilization.
Contribute to fostering a culture of accountability, learning, and safeguarding within the program.
Our Values
Accountable to Children: Children can rely on us to respond to their voices and to treat them with respect and dignity.
Transformative: Highlights our commitment to making real and sustainable improvements in the lives of children and communities, rather than simply continuing current practices.
Equitable Justice: Emphasizes fairness, inclusion, and addressing inequality, especially for marginalized children and communities.
Integrity: Integrity refers to ethical behavior, professionalism, and honesty in everything we do.

Job Requirements
Experience and mandatory criteria:
IT University Degree
At least 5 Years’ experience with humanitarian organizations related to IT and administration.
Proficiency in English, Pashto and Persian languages is highly essential, [i.e., reading, writing and speaking]
Highly objective, dependable, emotionally mature, sociable and communicative with good verbal and written communications skills.
Must possess good interpersonal, mediation, negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
Patient and with good understanding of humanitarian and development work.
Hardworking and able to work with people from different backgrounds.
Honest and accountable.
Flexible and can work under pressure.
Commitment to understanding War Child UK values.

Submission Guideline
Child safeguarding and Adults at Risk
Our work with children and at-risk adults to ensure their safety is our top priority. We are committed to safeguarding children and vulnerable adults in all aspects of our work. We maintain a zero-tolerance policy for any behavior or practices that put children and/or vulnerable adults at risk of abuse or harm.
Successful applicants will be required to comply with and sign our Safeguarding Policy, Code of Conduct, and PSEAH Policy. You can find the Safeguarding and Integrity policies here:
https://warchild.sharepoint.com/sites/Integrity
Pre-employment checks
Employment with War Child will be subject to the following checks prior to your start date:
a satisfactory police record check and a clear LexisNexis and Due Diligence check
receipt of three satisfactory references
Submission Guideline:
Fill in your information, and attach your documents before the closing date.
Applications of candidates submitted without a valid National ID will not be considered for shortlisting.
Applications after the closing date will not be accepted.
Please note that there is no telephonic inquiry and only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for written test/interview.

title: Solidity Smart Contract Developer
description:
Job Title: Solidity Smart Contract Developer
Job Location: San Francisco, CA, USA
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level: Mid-Senior level
About NodeMeta NodeMetais a Web3 ecosystem built on BNB Smart Chain, founded in August 2025 by SohelMazumder. We're not building another copy-paste DeFi fork — we're creating realproducts that connect blockchain utility to everyday use cases.
Ournative token NTE (Node Meta Energy) is live on BNB Smart Chain with a cappedsupply of 11 billion tokens and a 10-year halving strategy. The mining andstaking ecosystem is already operational, with users earning daily rewardsthrough our decentralized node-based infrastructure.
Wewere recognized as the BestDecentralized Ecosystem at the 2025 Evergreen Awards — and now we'rebuilding the team to deliver on the next phase.
What We're Building — Product Development Status NodeMetais developing four interconnected products. Here's what's live, what's inactive development, and where this role fits in:
1. Mining Staking Ecosystem
Status: LIVE ✓
Thefoundation of NodeMeta. Users participate in a decentralized node-based miningsystem and earn daily NTE rewards. The staking smart contracts are deployed onBSC mainnet and operational. This is the revenue-generating backbone of theecosystem — real users, real tokens, real on-chain activity.
Your involvement: Maintain, optimize, and extendexisting staking contracts. Improve gas efficiency and prepare for the nextphase of staking features (NFT-based staking, tiered reward structures).
2. NFT Marketplace
Status: IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT — architecturephase
Adecentralized marketplace for NFTs with a differentiator: real-world utility.NFTs on our platform aren't just collectibles — they unlock benefits, access,and rewards within the NodeMeta ecosystem. The marketplace will supportminting, listing, bidding, trading, and on-chain staking of NFTs withper-second reward accrual.
Your involvement: This is the core of your role.You'll design and implement the marketplace smart contracts from scratch —BEP-721/BEP-1155 minting, trading/auction logic, and the NFT staking engine(reward calculation, lock-up periods, safe withdrawal flows). You'll own thecontract architecture.
3. SmartCommerce
Status: IN DEVELOPMENT — design phase
Aplatform where users spend NTE tokens on real digital and physical goods —bridging blockchain and everyday commerce. This is what makes NodeMetadifferent from most Web3 projects: we're building actual utility for the tokenbeyond speculation. SmartCommerce requires on-chain payment contracts,settlement logic, escrow mechanisms, and integration points with off-chainfulfillment systems.
Your involvement: Design the on-chain payment andsettlement contracts. Build the escrow logic that protects both buyers andsellers. Work closely with the backend team to ensure on-chain payments triggerreal-world fulfillment reliably.
4. GreenCommerce
Status: PLANNED
Anexclusive marketplace for environmentally friendly products — eco-consciouselectronics, reusable home products, green building materials, and clean energysolutions. GreenCommerce will share the SmartCommerce contract infrastructurewith additional sustainability-focused features.
Your involvement: Future phase. Contracts you buildfor SmartCommerce will be extended for GreenCommerce, so your architecturaldecisions now directly shape this product.
What You'll Do Asour Solidity Smart Contract Developer, your day-to-day work spans three productareas:
NFT MarketplaceContracts
▸ Designand implement NFT minting contracts (BEP-721 and BEP-1155)
▸ Buildtrading logic — listings, bids, auctions, direct sales with escrow
▸ Implementthe staking engine — per-second reward accrual, lock-up periods, safewithdrawal with reentrancy protection
▸ Designthe reward token distribution mechanism for staked NFTs
SmartCommerce PaymentContracts
▸ Buildon-chain payment acceptance and validation logic
▸ Designescrow contracts for buyer/seller protection

title: Webflow Developer
description:
Overview
We’re 8020 — We help companies + creators like Wave , Vanta , Superlist , , Huberman Lab , Hasan Minhaj , Alltrue , Helix (Q2) , and many more move faster without code. Whether they’re a seed-stage startup or a publicly-traded enterprise, brands around the world every day rely on 8020 to design, develop, and launch the internet's most ambitious websites.
About This Opening
We're seeking a talented Webflow Developer to join temporarily our remote team at 8020 . With a strong reputation in the industry, we’re offering the chance to contribute to forward-thinking Webflow projects for some of the largest names on the internet. As part of a collaborative team, you can work alongside exceptional project managers, designers, and senior developers, creating an environment that encourages personal and professional development.
What We're Looking For
Experience: You're an experienced developer with at least 2 or 3 years of Webflow experience and a portfolio of past work to showcase. You have a strong track record of delivering successful Webflow sites in business settings.
Efficient: You're comfortable using a development framework like Mast or similar frameworks, and constantly seek opportunities to improve your workflow + speed.
Communicative: You excel in asynchronous communication through written channels (Slack, ClickUp) or video (Loom) and consistently engage with teammates and clients. You communicate clearly and professionally in English — both in writing and on video calls. You'll regularly collaborate with native English speakers, including clients, so confident spoken English is important.
Methodical: Whether writing code snippets or developing complete websites for clients, you meticulously ensure semantic, performant, and optimized deliverables that drive client success. You rigorously test and review your work before deploying it to production.
Proactive: During periods of free time, you proactively identify and engage in side projects that align with company objectives, enabling skill growth.
What You'll Do
Figma to Webflow: You'll primarily collaborate with our design team or clients, translating design files (often in Figma) into dynamic, visually appealing websites.
Perform Audits: We often begin retainer or replatforming projects with a comprehensive audit to identify high-impact opportunities for our partners. You will need to evaluate websites from several perspectives including SEO, accessibility, and performance, and translate your findings into clear and strategic recommendations.
Retainer Services: In some cases, you'll collaborate closely with clients on an ongoing basis, serving as an extension of their team. Retainer work necessitates exceptional communication skills and the ability to foster strong relationships.
Be a Good Partner: At 8020 , we pride ourselves on being an exceptional and trusted partner to our clients. We approach decision-making as if we were owners of their businesses and rely on you to assist clients in making strategic choices for their success.
Migrations: You have experience supporting website migrations, including organizing and mapping large sets of content. You are comfortable working with Airtable or similar tools to structure data, and you understand Webflow’s CMS capabilities well enough to propose clear and scalable ways to manage that data during and after the migration.
Where You'll Do It‍
This is a remote-first position open to candidates anywhere in the world. Significant preference will be given to candidates available to work during the Eastern to Pacific time zones.
‍Who Will Be Prioritized
Developers with a proven track record of successfully collaborating with clients or stakeholders in professional environments.
Developers with proficiency in Webflow's underlying code output: HTML, CSS, and basic Javascript. (If you have moderate-to-advanced proficiency in writing Javascript or JQuery, we recommend noting it in your application.)

title: Senior IT Security Officer
description:
Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior IT Security Officer to join our team and oversee the protection and security of our organization's IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving efforts to prevent, monitor, and respond to information/data breaches and cyber-attacks, ensuring the execution of Information Security directives and activities in alignment with the company's data security policy.

Duties and Responsibilities
1. Design, update, and enforce enterprise-wide security policies, standards, and procedures aligned with industry frameworks and Organization’s security policies.
2. Coordinate security awareness programs and train employees on cybersecurity best practices, threat recognition and ensure compliance with security regulations and standards.
3. Oversee the execution of comprehensive security assessments and compliance audits to proactively identify vulnerabilities and recommend security enhancements.
4. Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, security audits, and risk analyses to identify gaps and implement effective mitigation strategies.
5. Ensure security incidents are managed and forensic investigations are executed when necessary.
6. Cross-functional collaboration is maintained to systematically address emerging security concerns and implement security best practices.
7. Lead the detection, investigation, and response efforts for security breaches, cyberattacks, or system anomalies
8. Provide strategic guidance and recommendations to enhance the organization's overall security posture.
9. A comprehensive understanding of current security trends, advanced threat, and emerging technologies is maintained to ensure potential systemic risks are proactively mitigated.
10. Develop and maintain security incident response plans and procedures.
11. Lead and mentor a team of security professionals to ensure effective execution of security initiatives.
12. Act as a technical liaison to upper management, legal teams, and external auditors to ensure regulatory and data privacy compliance.
13. Ensure compliance with industry regulations, standards, and best practices.
14. Supervise and maintain security systems, including firewalls, SIEM platforms, and endpoint protection tools.

Job Requirements
Qualifications & Skills
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
· Proven experience in a senior-level information security role, with a strong track record of implementing, managing, and improving information security programs and initiatives.
· A minimum of 2–4 years of relevant experience in IT, information security, or cybersecurity.
· In-depth knowledge of information security principles, best practices, and technologies, including network security, encryption, identity and access management, risk management, and security incident response.
· Excellent communication, leadership, and analytical skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical risks to non-technical stakeholders, and report security matters to senior management.
· Certification of ISO/IEC 27001, CompTIA Security +, CISSP, CISM are highly preferred.
Personal Attributes
· High level of integrity and ability to handle sensitive financial systems
· Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure
· Detail-oriented with a strong focus on documentation and audit readiness

Submission Guidelines
Interested and qualified candidates are invited to submit their CV and cover letter (in PDF format) to jobs@aurumaf.com
Please mention the position title “Senior IT Security Officer” in the subject line of your email.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview

title: Dutch Audio Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
Project Overview
We are sourcing independent Audio Evaluation Specialists for an AI benchmark evaluation project assessing advanced agentic audio models. As AI models increasingly handle complex workflows in this domain—specifically real-world customer support scenarios like flight bookings, financial services, and telecommunications—their accuracy relies entirely on robust, expert-crafted training data. The objective of this project is to autonomously produce high-quality evaluation tasks through simulated interactions, audit conversational AI outputs, and generate clean, reliable datasets to optimize model performance.
Project Deliverables & Scope
Operate autonomously to design complex evaluation frameworks and provide structured training data. Expected deliverables include:
Role-Play Scenario Execution: Creating and executing complex, role-play-based evaluation scenarios that simulate realistic customer service interactions across travel, finance, and technical support domains.
Model Performance Auditing: Evaluating AI model performance across standardized qualitative and quantitative metrics, focusing strictly on task completion accuracy, conversational naturalness, and audio comprehension.
Technical Metric Evaluation: Assessing the model's basic computer programming literacy, including its understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and ability to reason about structured data within a support context.
Representative Dataset Generation: Contributing to the development of diverse, high-quality audio datasets that accurately reflect real customer expectations for clarity, efficiency, and natural conversational flow.
Required Expertise
To successfully fulfill the deliverables of this project, Contractors must possess deep industry knowledge to craft realistic professional scenarios. Core skillset includes:
Demonstrable professional expertise in complex customer support, technical troubleshooting, or conversational AI evaluation.
Native or bilingual proficiency in the target language, including fluency across all language skills (reading, listening, writing, and speaking), alongside strong analytical and verbal communication skills to confidently conduct simulated customer support role-plays.
Basic computer programming literacy, specifically a comfortable understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and simple logic.
A meticulous, detail-oriented approach to working with structured prompts, complex evaluation rubrics, and technical guidelines.
Required Equipment: Access to a high-quality microphone to ensure clean, reliable audio input during voice evaluations.
We offer a pay range of $6-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. Project Overview
We are sourcing independent Audio Evaluation Specialists for an AI benchmark evaluation project assessing advanced agentic audio models. As AI models increasingly handle complex workflows in this domain—specifically real-world customer support scenarios like flight bookings, financial services, and telecommunications—their accuracy relies entirely on robust, expert-crafted training data. The objective of this project is to autonomously produce high-quality evaluation tasks through simulated interactions, audit conversational AI outputs, and generate clean, reliable datasets to optimize model performance.
Project Deliverables & Scope
Operate autonomously to design complex evaluation frameworks and provide structured training data. Expected deliverables include:
Role-Play Scenario Execution: Creating and executing complex, role-play-based evaluation scenarios that simulate realistic customer service interactions across travel, finance, and technical support domains.
Model Performance Auditing: Evaluating AI model performance across standardized qualitative and quantitative metrics, focusing strictly on task completion accuracy, conversational naturalness, and audio comprehension.
Technical Metric Evaluation: Assessing the model's basic computer programming literacy, including its understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and ability to reason about structured data within a support context.
Representative Dataset Generation: Contributing to the development of diverse, high-quality audio datasets that accurately reflect real customer expectations for clarity, efficiency, and natural conversational flow.
Required Expertise
To successfully fulfill the deliverables of this project, Contractors must possess deep industry knowledge to craft realistic professional scenarios. Core skillset includes:
Demonstrable professional expertise in complex customer support, technical troubleshooting, or conversational AI evaluation.
Native or bilingual proficiency in the target language, including fluency across all language skills (reading, listening, writing, and speaking), alongside strong analytical and verbal communication skills to confidently conduct simulated customer support role-plays.
Basic computer programming literacy, specifically a comfortable understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and simple logic.
A meticulous, detail-oriented approach to working with structured prompts, complex evaluation rubrics, and technical guidelines.
Required Equipment: Access to a high-quality microphone to ensure clean, reliable audio input during voice evaluations.
We offer a pay range of $6-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. description:
Job Summary
هدف وظیفه: مدیریت، نظارت و مراقبت از نرم افزار ها، امور تکنالوژی معلوماتی، نظام، و کامره های امنیتی ریاست عمومی کیفیت مواد نفتی، ایجاد و انکشاف بموقع برنامه ها مطابق معیارات بین المللی و نیازمندی های عملیاتی ریاست عمومی کیفیت مواد نفتی .

Job Requirements
صلاحیت و مسئولیت های وظیفوی:
وظایف تخصصی:
مطالعه و تدقیق پروسه های کاری غرض تطبیق و مراقبت نظام ها (دیتابیس ها) و پیشنهاد راه حل جهت رفع موانع و چالش های نظام های متذکره .
تطبیق و مراقبت نظام ها و وبسایت های اداره بر حسب پالیسی های موجود؛ با استفاده از تکنالوژی های معتبر عصر جدید .
تدوین و تطبیق طرح ها، پروسیجر های جدید کاری، طرز العمل ها و پلان عمل مطابق استراتیژی ریاست عمومی کیفیت مواد نفتی غرض تسریع روند حکومتداری الکترونیکی و ساده سازی پروسه های کاری .
حصول اطمینان از رفع مشکلات تخنیکی و مصئونیت نظام های اداره، تهیه Documentations ، و Backups .
حصول اطمینان از استفادۀ درست و مؤثر از نظام الکترونیکی ادارۀ به منظور هماهنگی، شفافیت و تسریع در پروسۀ کاری و اجراآت لازم طبق هدایت مقام ذیصلاح بخش .
مطالعه برنامه های جدید و اجراآت دوامدار غرض Update و توسعه نرم افزار های مورد استفاده ریاست عمومی کیفیت مواد نفتی .
اشتراک در کنفرانس ها و ورکشاپ های مربوط به نظام سازی جهت ارتقاء ظرفیت .
ارتباط موثر با اعضای تیم و Stakeholders به صورت شفاهی و کتبی غرض بهبود امور و سیستم های موجود وزارت مالیه .
رهبری و نظارت از فعالیت های تخنیکی و مسلکی مدیریت های عمومی کامره های امنیتی، تکنالوژی معلوماتی و نظام به منظور تأمین فعالیت مؤثر و منظم امور مربوطه.
نظارت از تنظیم صلاحیت های استفاده کننده ګان نظام معلوماتی مطابق مسؤولیت های وظیفوی و صلاحیت های منظور شده آنان و پیګری مشکلات مربوط به دسترسی و استفاده از نظام.
وظایف مدیریتی:
ترتیب و جمع آوری پلان کاری و راپور های ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه در مطابقت با پلان عمومی، بمنظور رسیدن به اهداف تعیین شده اداره.
انتقال مهارت های مسلکی به شیوه تدویر ورکشاپ ها، سیمینار ها و آموزش های جریان کار به کارکنان تحت اثر .
مدیریت، ارزیابی اجراات، تعیین نیاز های آموزشی و ارتقای ظرفیت کارکنان و بخش های تحت اثر
ارائه گزارش ماهوار، ربعوار، سالانه و عندالضرورت از فعالیت ها و دست آورد های مربوطه، بمنظور مطلع ساختن رهبری وزارت/اداره؛
اجرای سایر وظایف که از طرف مقامات ذیصلاح مطابق قوانین، مقررات و اهداف وزارت/ اداره مربوطه سپرده میشود .
وظایف هماهنگی:
تامین ارتباط و هماهنگی با ادارات و بخش های مربوطه به منظور انسجام امور بهتر.
شرایط استخدام :
تابعیت افغانستان را داشته باشد.
سن وی از (18) سال کمتر و از (64) سال بیشتر نباشد.
(سطح تحصیل و تجربه کاری):
رشته تحصیلی:
داشتن سند تحصیلی حداقل لیسانس در یکی از رشته های ( کمپیوترساینس، سیستم های معلوماتی و انجنیری نرم افزار ) داخل یا خارج کشور که به تائید وزارت تحصیلات عالی رسیده باشد.
تجربه کاری: حداقل چهار سال مرتبط به وظیفه .
مهارت های لازم:
توانائی رهنمائی و کنترول بخش مربوطه.
قابلیت طرح و تعین خط مشی (پالیسی ) اداره/ وزارت مربوطه.
تسلط به هر دو زبان ‌های رسمی ملی (پشتو و دری) و آشنایی با زبان انگلیسی؛
مهارت ‌های کمپیوتری در برنامه ‌های مرتبط به وظیفه مربوطه.
بلدیت با تکنالوژی های ویب، فریم ورک ها و کتابخانه ها، مانند:
JavaScript, React, Next.js, Version control systems, and Agile methodology
مهارت تحلیل نیازمندی ها، حل مساله ها و کارتیمی.
بلدیت با دیتابیس های SQL , NoSQL
بلدیت با SDLC و Main software Engineering principles
بلدیت به زبان های برنامه نویسی، مانند: Java, Python, PHP, C#

title: معاونیت انکشاف صادرات ریاست هئیت عامل اتاق تجارت و سرمایه گذاری افغانستان
company: Afghanistan Chamber of Commerce and Investment - ACCI
category: Customer Care, Customer Service, Business Development and Growth, Telecommunication
description:
Role Summary
رهبری، مدیریت، هماهنگی و نظارت بر فعالیت‌های مربوط به انکشاف و تسهیل صادرات کشور، حمایت از صادرکنندگان، شناسایی و رفع موانع صادراتی، بهبود خدمات و معیارهای صادراتی، تسهیل روندهای گمرکی و اسناد صادراتی و فراهم‌سازی زمینه‌های دسترسی محصولات و تولیدات افغانستان به بازارهای داخلی و بین‌المللی، به منظور افزایش حجم و تنوع صادرات کشور .

Duties and Responsibilities
وظایف و مسئولیت‌های اساسی
۱ . رهبری، مدیریت و نظارت بر فعالیت‌های مربوط به معاونیت انکشاف صادرات و حصول اطمینان از اجرای مؤثر وظایف واحدهای مربوطه .
۲ . طرح، ترتیب و تطبیق پالیسی‌ها، برنامه‌ها، پلان‌های کاری و استراتیژی‌های کوتاه‌مدت و درازمدت در راستای انکشاف و افزایش صادرات کشور .
۳ . شناسایی و ارزیابی مشکلات، چالش‌ها و موانع موجود در مسیر صادرات و ارائه پیشنهادات و راهکارهای عملی جهت رفع آن‌ها به مراجع ذی‌ربط .
۴ . حمایت و ارائه مشوره‌های مسلکی به صادرکنندگان در زمینه پروسه‌های صادراتی، شرایط ورود به بازارهای خارجی، معیارهای بین‌المللی، بسته‌بندی، کیفیت و تصدیق‌نامه‌های مورد نیاز .
۵ . هماهنگی با وزارت‌ها، ادارات دولتی، نهادهای گمرکی، ترانسپورتی و سایر مراجع ذی‌ربط به منظور تسهیل روند صادرات و کاهش موانع اداری و اجرایی .
۶ . نظارت بر ارائه خدمات صادراتی، بهبود کیفیت خدمات و تسهیل روند صدور اسناد و تصدیق‌نامه‌های صادراتی در چارچوب صلاحیت‌ها و وظایف قانونی اتاق .
۷ . پیگیری موضوعات مربوط به استندردسازی، کیفیت محصولات، ارزیابی مطابقت، تصدیق مبدأ و سایر الزامات تخنیکی و تجارتی مرتبط با صادرات .
۸ . تلاش در راستای شناسایی بازارهای جدید صادراتی، فرصت‌های تجارتی منطقه‌ای و بین‌المللی و فراهم‌سازی زمینه ارتباط میان صادرکنندگان افغان و خریداران خارجی .
۹ . هماهنگی با نهادهای ملی و بین‌المللی به منظور برگزاری برنامه‌های آموزشی، ورکشاپ‌ها، نشست‌های تخصصی و برنامه‌های ارتقای ظرفیت صادرکنندگان .
۱۰ . پیگیری مشکلات صادرکنندگان در گمرکات، میدان‌های هوایی و مسیرهای ترانزیتی و تلاش برای تسهیل انتقال و صدور محصولات صادراتی .
۱۱ . نظارت بر جمع‌آوری، تحلیل و ارائه معلومات و آمار مربوط به صادرات کشور، شناسایی روندها و فرصت‌های صادراتی و استفاده از آن در تصمیم‌گیری‌ها و برنامه‌ریزی‌ها .
۱۲ . حمایت از توسعه صادرات محصولات زراعتی، صنعتی، معدنی و سایر تولیدات داخلی و ارائه پیشنهادات جهت افزایش ارزش افزوده و تنوع‌بخشی به سبد صادراتی کشور .
۱۳ . ایجاد و تقویت هماهنگی میان صادرکنندگان، تولیدکنندگان، اتحادیه‌ها، انجمن‌های تجارتی و سایر تشکل‌های سکتور خصوصی در راستای حل مشکلات و انکشاف صادرات .
۱۴ . نظارت بر عملکرد آمریت‌ها و مدیریت‌های مربوطه، ارزیابی نتایج کاری و حصول اطمینان از اجرای به‌موقع پلان‌ها و فعالیت‌های منظورشده .
۱۵ . ترتیب گزارش‌های ادواری از فعالیت‌ها، دستاوردها، چالش‌ها و پیشنهادات معاونیت و ارائه آن به ریاست هیأت عامل .
۱۶ . ارائه پیشنهادات اصلاحی در زمینه ساده‌سازی طرزالعمل‌ها، کاهش هزینه‌های صادراتی و بهبود فضای تجارتی و صادراتی کشور .
۱۷ . نمایندگی از اتاق در جلسات، نشست‌ها، کنفرانس‌ها و برنامه‌های مرتبط با صادرات، در حدود صلاحیت تفویض‌شده .
۱۸ . اجرای سایر وظایف مرتبط به اهداف و مسئولیت‌های معاونیت که از طرف ریاست هیأت عامل مطابق قوانین، مقررات و پالیسی‌های اتاق سپرده می‌شود .

Job Requirements
شرایط تحصیلی
۱ . داشتن حداقل سند ماستری در یکی از رشته‌های ذیل :
اقتصاد؛
اداره و منجمنت؛
تجارت و مدیریت تجارت؛
پالیسی عامه و علوم انکشافی؛
اقتصاد بین‌المللی و تجارت بین‌المللی؛
روابط اقتصادی بین‌المللی؛
و سایر رشته‌های مرتبط با اهداف و مسئولیت‌های بست .
۲ . داشتن سند دکتورا در یکی از رشته‌های فوق، امتیاز تحصیلی بالاتر محسوب گردیده و در صورت داشتن سایر شرایط، حداقل تجربه کاری مورد نیاز برای این سطح تحصیلی دو سال می‌باشد .
تجربه کاری
۱ . حداقل سه سال تجربه کاری مرتبط در بخش‌های صادرات، تجارت بین‌المللی، انکشاف تجارت، پالیسی‌سازی اقتصادی، مدیریت برنامه‌های انکشافی یا سایر بخش‌های مرتبط برای دارندگان سند ماستری .
۲ . حداقل دو سال تجربه کاری مرتبط در بخش‌های فوق برای دارندگان سند دکتورا .
۳ . داشتن تجربه در بخش مدیریت، رهبری، هماهنگی و نظارت بر فعالیت‌های سازمانی و برنامه‌های مرتبط با تجارت و صادرات، امتیاز محسوب می‌گردد .
مهارت‌ها و توانایی‌های مسلکی
۱ . آشنایی کامل با اصول و مفاهیم تجارت بین‌المللی، صادرات، واردات و ترانزیت .
۲ . آشنایی با قوانین، مقررات، طرزالعمل‌ها و پالیسی‌های مرتبط با صادرات و تجارت افغانستان .
۳ . توانایی تحلیل و ارزیابی بازارهای صادراتی و شناسایی فرصت‌ها و موانع تجارتی .
۴ . توانایی تدوین پالیسی، استراتیژی، پلان‌های کاری و برنامه‌های انکشاف صادرات .
۵ . مهارت قوی در مدیریت، رهبری، تصمیم‌گیری، حل مشکلات و هماهنگی میان واحدهای سازمانی .
۶ . توانایی مذاکره، ایجاد ارتباطات مؤثر و تعامل با ادارات دولتی، نهادهای بین‌المللی و سکتور خصوصی .
۷ . تسلط بر زبان‌های رسمی کشور و آشنایی با زبان انگلیسی .
۸ . مهارت در استفاده از برنامه‌های کمپیوتر و سیستم‌های معلوماتی و گزارش‌دهی .
۹ . داشتن مهارت در تهیه و ارائه گزارش‌های تحلیلی، مسلکی و مدیریتی .
مهارت‌های زبانی
تسلط کامل به هردو زبان رسمی کشور (دری و پشتو) و توانایی خوب صحبت و تحریر به زبان رسمی دیگر .
آشنایی کامل با زبان انگلیسی، به‌ویژه در مکاتبات رسمی، تهیه گزارش‌ها و ارتباطات مسلکی .
مهارت‌های کمپیوتر
تسلط به برنامه‌های Microsoft Word ، Excel و PowerPoint.
توانایی استفاده مؤثر از انترنت، ایمیل و سیستم‌های ارتباطی و معلوماتی .
توانایی تهیه اسناد، گزارش‌ها، تحلیل معلومات و ارائه مطالب به‌صورت الکترونیکی .
معاش و امتیازات
- معاش و سایر امتیازات بست مطابق درجه و کتگوری تعیین‌شده در لایحه معاشات منظورشده اتاق تجارت و سرمایه‌گذاری افغانستان پرداخت می‌گردد .
شایستگی‌های رفتاری و مدیریتی
۱ . برخورداری از صداقت، امانت‌داری، تعهد مسلکی و مسئولیت‌پذیری .
۲ . داشتن روحیه ابتکار، خلاقیت و نتیجه‌گرایی .
۳ . توانایی کار گروهی و ایجاد هماهنگی مؤثر میان کارمندان و بخش‌های مربوطه .
۴ . رعایت اصول محرمیت، نظم اداری و اخلاق مسلکی .
۵ . برخورداری از ظرفیت رهبری، مدیریت تغییر و حل منازعات کاری .
۶ . توانایی مدیریت مؤثر زمان و اولویت‌بندی وظایف .
۷ . برخورداری از دیدگاه استراتیژیک و تعهد به انکشاف تجارت و صادرات کشور .

Submission Guidelines
متقاضیان گرامی،در خواست نامه ها خویش را در بست متذکره ارسال می نماید، لطف نموده نام بست را در بخش موضوع ایمیل واضح سازید واسناد تحصیلی همرا با سی وی تان درج یک پی دی اف نموده قبل از تاریخ 24 عقرب 1405 به ایمیل‌آدرس های ذیل ارسال نماید.

Project Deliverables & Scope
Operate autonomously to design complex evaluation frameworks and provide structured training data. Expected deliverables include:
Role-Play Scenario Execution: Creating and executing complex, role-play-based evaluation scenarios that simulate realistic customer service interactions across travel, finance, and technical support domains.
Model Performance Auditing: Evaluating AI model performance across standardized qualitative and quantitative metrics, focusing strictly on task completion accuracy, conversational naturalness, and audio comprehension.
Technical Metric Evaluation: Assessing the model's basic computer programming literacy, including its understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and ability to reason about structured data within a support context.
Representative Dataset Generation: Contributing to the development of diverse, high-quality audio datasets that accurately reflect real customer expectations for clarity, efficiency, and natural conversational flow.
Required Expertise
To successfully fulfill the deliverables of this project, Contractors must possess deep industry knowledge to craft realistic professional scenarios. Core skillset includes:
Demonstrable professional expertise in complex customer support, technical troubleshooting, or conversational AI evaluation.
Native or bilingual proficiency in the target language, including fluency across all language skills (reading, listening, writing, and speaking), alongside strong analytical and verbal communication skills to confidently conduct simulated customer support role-plays.
Basic computer programming literacy, specifically a comfortable understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and simple logic.
A meticulous, detail-oriented approach to working with structured prompts, complex evaluation rubrics, and technical guidelines.
Required Equipment: Access to a high-quality microphone to ensure clean, reliable audio input during voice evaluations.
We offer a pay range of $6-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

title: WASH Engineer
location: Zabul - Zabul ( Arghandab, Mezan, and Tarnak Jaldak)
description:
Job Summary
The WASH Engineer works under the direct supervision of the Project Manager and is responsible for the technical assessment, design, implementation, supervision, and monitoring of assigned water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) infrastructure activities.
The position ensures that WASH facilities are appropriately selected, technically sound, cost-effective, inclusive, and implemented in accordance with approved designs, technical specifications, project work plans, donor requirements, and PIN quality standards.
The WASH Engineer conducts field surveys, prepares engineering drawings and bills of quantities (BoQs), supports preliminary market price assessments, supervises contractors, verifies construction progress and quality, reviews contractor invoices, and supports the establishment and capacity building of community based WASH structures.
The position also maintains technical documentation and infrastructure databases, coordinates with communities and relevant authorities, and ensures the proper completion and handover of facilities to communities in coordination with the Project Manager and relevant project staff.
3. RESPONSIBILITIES
A. Technical Assessment, Site Selection and Project Planning
· Conduct field surveys and technical assessments to identify WASH infrastructure needs, site conditions, feasibility, and implementation requirements.
· Support the selection of appropriate sites and WASH interventions based on technical feasibility, community needs, accessibility, sustainability, and approved project criteria.
· Assess existing water supply and sanitation facilities to identify rehabilitation needs, operational constraints, and opportunities for improvement.
· Consult communities, relevant authorities, and project staff during site assessments to ensure that proposed interventions respond to identified needs.
· Assess relevant environmental, social, land-access, safety, and protection considerations before recommending infrastructure sites.
· Prepare technical assessment reports with findings, recommendations, site information, and proposed interventions.
· Contribute to activity planning and implementation schedules, ensuring that technical deliverables align with approved project work plans and donor deadlines.
· Identify technical risks, resource requirements, and implementation constraints, and report recommendations to the Project Manager.
B. Engineering Design, Drawings, BoQs and Cost Estimation
· Prepare engineering drawings, technical designs, specifications, and construction details for assigned WASH infrastructure activities.
· Develop accurate bills of quantities (BoQs) and preliminary cost estimates based on approved designs and site-specific requirements.
· Collect and document initial market prices for construction materials, equipment, and other required items to support realistic cost estimates and budgeting.
· Review technical designs and BoQs for completeness, constructability, cost-effectiveness, and compliance with applicable standards.
· Incorporate relevant feedback from the Project Manager, technical colleagues, and other authorized reviewers into designs and BoQs.
· Revise drawings, specifications, and BoQs when justified by field conditions or approved changes to project requirements.
· Provide technical inputs to procurement documentation, including material specifications, quantities, and quality requirements.
· Ensure that final technical designs, BoQs, and specifications receive the required internal approval before implementation or procurement.
· Maintain organized records of approved designs, drawings, specifications, BoQs, and subsequent revisions.
C. Construction Supervision and Quality Assurance
· Conduct regular site visits to monitor ongoing construction and rehabilitation works against approved designs, BoQs, specifications, and implementation schedules.
· Supervise contractors' technical performance and verify that construction activities comply with contractual requirements and approved engineering standards.
· Inspect construction materials, workmanship, dimensions, and completed work to confirm compliance with approved specifications.
· Verify site measurements and completed quantities to support progress tracking, payment assessments, and quality assurance.
· Identify construction defects, deviations, delays, and technical risks, and communicate corrective actions to contractors through the approved project management arrangements.
· Maintain accurate site inspection records, progress photographs, measurement sheets, and other relevant construction documentation.
· Monitor contractor performance against agreed milestones and report significant delays or non-compliance to the Project Manager.
· Review proposed technical changes and provide recommendations to the Project Manager before implementation.
· Ensure that corrective works and outstanding defects are addressed before recommending technical acceptance of completed facilities.
· Monitor compliance with relevant occupational health and safety, environmental protection, and site safety requirements during construction.
D. Contractor Coordination, Work Verification and Invoice Review
· Coordinate with contractors on technical requirements, work schedules, site access, construction progress, and quality expectations.
· Explain approved drawings, technical specifications, and construction requirements to contractors and clarify technical issues within the assigned authority.
· Verify reported work progress against actual site conditions, approved BoQs, contractual milestones, and inspection records.
· Review contractor invoices and payment claims against verified quantities, completed work, contractual rates, and supporting documentation.
· Prepare or revise technical measurement sheets, quantity calculations, and invoice verification records as required.
· Recommend approval, correction, or rejection of payment claims based on technical verification and documented findings.
· Report discrepancies, unsupported claims, variations, and contractual non-compliance to the Project Manager for appropriate action.
· Maintain complete technical records supporting contractor performance monitoring, invoice verification, and project expenditure documentation.
E. Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene Infrastructure
· Provide technical support for the construction, rehabilitation, and improvement of water supply, sanitation, and related WASH facilities.
· Assess water sources, boreholes, wells, reservoirs, distribution networks, and associated infrastructure to determine technical suitability and rehabilitation requirements.
· Support appropriate water-source testing, pumping tests, yield assessments, and other relevant technical investigations in coordination with qualified personnel.
· Verify the functionality, structural integrity, and operational suitability of completed water supply and sanitation facilities.
· Ensure that water supply infrastructure is designed with due consideration for water demand, source yield, storage capacity, distribution arrangements, and operational sustainability.
· Support the technical planning and improvement of sanitation facilities, considering safe waste management, accessibility, privacy, and user needs.
· Coordinate with Hygiene Promoters to align infrastructure activities with hygiene promotion and community awareness interventions.
· Identify technical requirements for the operation, maintenance, and long-term functionality of WASH facilities and communicate recommendations to the Project Manager.
F. Community Engagement and WASH Committee Establishment
· Conduct WASH-related meetings with communities to discuss identified needs, proposed infrastructure, site selection, implementation arrangements, and operational requirements.
· Facilitate the establishment or strengthening of community-based WASH committees in accordance with project procedures and community context.
· Support transparent community participation in infrastructure selection, implementation monitoring, facility management, and handover processes.
· Explain the intended use, operation, maintenance requirements, and limitations of WASH facilities to community representatives and users.
· Coordinate with community leaders and relevant authorities to facilitate site access, resolve routine implementation issues, and promote community acceptance.
· Identify community concerns, access barriers, and potential disputes affecting infrastructure implementation, and report them to the Project Manager.
· Promote inclusive participation of women, persons with disabilities, and other relevant community groups in WASH consultations, subject to applicable access and safeguarding requirements.
G. Capacity Building and Operation and Maintenance
· Assess the capacity-building needs of community-based mechanics and other designated personnel responsible for maintaining WASH facilities.
· Deliver or facilitate practical training for community-based mechanics on routine maintenance, basic troubleshooting, and appropriate use of tools and equipment.
· Support communities in establishing practical operation and maintenance arrangements for completed water supply and sanitation facilities.
· Provide technical guidance on preventive maintenance, common breakdowns, spare parts, and procedures for reporting technical faults.
· Monitor the functionality of handed-over facilities during assigned follow-up visits and identify maintenance or repair requirements.
· Maintain records of trained mechanics, training activities, maintenance arrangements, and identified technical support needs.
· Recommend additional technical support or refresher training when community maintenance capacity requires strengthening.
H. Infrastructure Database and Technical Documentation
· Develop and maintain an accurate database of newly constructed, rehabilitated, and existing WASH facilities covered by the project.
· Record relevant facility information, including location, GPS coordinates where available, infrastructure type, technical specifications, construction status, capacity, and operational functionality.
· Maintain updated records of site assessments, engineering drawings, BoQs, contractor progress, inspection findings, and completion documentation.
· Document infrastructure progress through field reports, photographs, measurement records, and other approved reporting tools.
· Ensure that technical records are complete, consistent, securely maintained, and accessible to authorized project personnel.
· Update infrastructure records following approved design revisions, construction completion, facility handover, or subsequent functionality assessments.
I. Coordination, Planning and Reporting
· Coordinate regularly with the Project Manager, Senior Field Officer, Field Officers, Hygiene Promoters, and other relevant colleagues to align technical activities with project priorities.
· Maintain communication with relevant authorities, community representatives, contractors, and technical stakeholders regarding assigned WASH interventions.
· Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly technical work plans and progress updates, as required by the Project Manager.
· Monitor technical deliverables against approved project milestones and donor timelines, promptly reporting delays and proposing corrective measures.
· Prepare field assessment reports, site inspection reports, construction progress reports, and technical completion reports within established deadlines.
· Provide timely technical information and supporting evidence for donor reporting, project reviews, monitoring visits, and internal documentation.
· Participate in relevant WASH coordination meetings, technical discussions, and field assessments as requested.
· Communicate technical risks, changes in site conditions, contractor performance concerns, and resource requirements to the Project Manager.
· Coordinate with Logistics and Procurement teams on technical specifications, material requirements, and quality verification, as required.
J. Facility Completion, Handover and Sustainability
· Conduct final technical inspections to verify that completed facilities comply with approved designs, contractual specifications, and required quality standards.
· Prepare technical completion reports documenting completed works, verified quantities, outstanding defects, and recommendations for acceptance.
· Compile handover documentation, including approved drawings, relevant technical specifications, facility details, and operation and maintenance guidance.
· Support the preparation and signing of facility handover documents in coordination with the Project Manager, relevant authorities, and community representatives.
· Facilitate the handover of completed facilities to designated community structures or responsible authorities following the required technical and administrative approvals.
· Explain operation, maintenance, and reporting arrangements to designated facility operators and community representatives during handover.
· Identify outstanding defects or incomplete works and follow up on their resolution before recommending final acceptance.
· Support post-handover monitoring, where required, to assess facility functionality and identify sustainability concerns.
K. Compliance, Safety and Other Responsibilities
· Apply PIN policies, donor requirements, relevant engineering standards, and approved project procedures throughout assigned technical activities.
· Integrate environmental protection, safeguarding, gender sensitivity, disability inclusion, and conflict-sensitive considerations into infrastructure planning and implementation.
· Comply with PIN's safety and security procedures during field visits, site inspections, and construction supervision.
· Report safety incidents, suspected fraud, misconduct, construction irregularities, and other compliance concerns through established reporting channels.
· Protect confidential project and community information and obtain appropriate consent before collecting or using photographs or other identifiable information.
· Perform other relevant technical duties assigned by the Project Manager that are consistent with the position and project requirements
4. PIN COMPETENCY MODEL
PIN Competency Model is a framework used to define, assess, and develop the behaviours, skills, and attitudes expected from staff. It focuses on how people perform their work, not only on their technical knowledge.
WASH Engineer will be recruited, and subsequently evaluated, following the PIN competency areas here below, where the staff is expected to at least meet the expectations as outlined below:
1. Personal integrity and values:
Demonstrates honesty, accountability, and consistency in actions and communication. Adheres to PIN’s values, policies, and ethical standards, addresses inappropriate conduct, and continuously reflects on and improves personal performance.
2. Universal competencies
o Communication: Communicates clearly and effectively, adapting messages to different audiences. Shares information in a timely manner, listens actively, encourages dialogue, and uses evidence to support decisions and recommendations.
o Cooperation: Builds positive and inclusive working relationships, values diverse perspectives, and promotes teamwork. Shares knowledge, supports collaboration, and addresses conflicts constructively.
o Resilience/coping with stress: Maintains composure and effectiveness under pressure. Manages stress constructively, remains solution-oriented, and adapts well to challenges and changing circumstances.
3. Specific competencies
o Problems and tasks solving approach: Analyses issues, identifies root causes, and makes informed decisions. Proactively solves problems, collaborates with others, and seeks practical improvements and innovative solutions.
o Result Orientation: Takes ownership of objectives, delivers high-quality results, and continuously seeks opportunities to improve performance and outcomes.

Job Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering/ relevant field.
Minimum of 3 years of demonstrated experience implementing humanitarian responses in the country.
Required Experience and Competencies
Demonstrated experience implementing WASH projects and conducting WASH field surveys, technical assessments, and site selection for water supply and sanitation infrastructure.
Demonstrated experience preparing engineering drawings, technical specifications, bills of quantities (BoQs), and preliminary cost estimates.
Proven ability to supervise contractors, monitor construction progress, verify work quality, and identify technical implementation challenges.
Demonstrated experience preparing technical reports, maintaining infrastructure databases, and documenting construction progress and completion.
Demonstrated experience coordinating with local communities, relevant authorities, contractors, and field-level stakeholders on WASH interventions.
Knowledge of water supply systems, sanitation facilities, water storage, distribution networks, and infrastructure operation and maintenance.
Demonstrated ability to verify construction quantities, review contractor invoices, and maintain accurate technical records.

Lead the transition and ongoing operation of business-critical telecom applications.

Troubleshoot complex signaling and integration issues involving SS7/SIGTRAN, CAMEL/MAP, SIP and SMPP.
Lead production incidents, root-cause investigations and permanent corrective actions.
Plan and validate deployments, failover, disaster recovery, and rollback procedures.
Establish change controls, support escalation, technical documentation, and engineering standards.
Train internal engineers and ensure backup coverage for critical systems.

Allocate technical ownership and deputies across CAMELOCK, GMLC, VLRInsert/VLRDump, PromoSMS, SMS152, Cedar, NUMAN, WEBCC, WFM and CCSM/CARE. Maintain a service and dependency map covering application code, signaling, databases, hosting and external interfaces.
Lead hands-on software design and code reviews. Develop and debug services, APIs, middleware and adapters; guide testing and controlled releases. Verify code quality, security, performance, dependencies, rollback, access and source rights.
Preserve working services during handover. Plan current-system takeover and knowledge transfer alongside separately controlled upgrades; define reconciliation, rollback and business acceptance before migration.
Coordinate engineering priorities and capacity with Director IT/IP/RAFM and the responsible team managers. Set realistic recovery and support arrangements, review material security risks, and escalate unresolved dependencies.

Work closely with PS Core, Signaling/SPS, IN, HLR/HSS, Billing, OSS/BSS, IT Development, DWH & Mediation, BI, VAS, Network Information Security, IP/MPLS and IT System Administration Team (SAT) to agree interfaces, dependencies, support ownership, test evidence and coordinated changes.
Respect each team’s authority for its systems and obtain its support for integration, incident resolution and recovery.
Lead cross-team architecture and service-flow reviews: PS Core for packet-service dependencies; Signaling/SPS for signaling transport and routing; IN and HLR/HSS for charging, subscriber and provisioning interfaces; VAS for service and messaging flows; IT Development for middleware and APIs; DWH & Mediation and BI for data and report reconciliation.
Agree security and access controls with Network Information Security, routing/connectivity with IP/MPLS, and assigned operational dependencies with IT System Administration Team (SAT).
Coordinate joint incident analysis, change windows, rollback, and recovery ownership.
Agree on Billing and OSS/BSS interfaces for charging, billing records, product/service orders, provisioning status and operational alarms; define end-to-end ownership, reconciliation and joint acceptance.

A complete service ownership and dependency map for all ten applications.
Controlled technical handover with practical competency checks and documented recovery plans.
Engineering priorities, release decisions and incident actions supported by evidence.

Maintain hands-on capability to implement, review, debug and test Python, Java, Go and JavaScript/TypeScript services as used in the estate. Review middleware/adapters, API contracts, authentication, retries, idempotency, observability and applicable TM Forum Open API integration with the responsible engineers.

Protect live services and data through approved access, tested changes, verified rollback and authorised production deployment or maintenance. Escalate unavailable access, unsupported dependencies and material risks; retain evidence of change and recovery outcomes.

description:
Job Summary
Purpose of the Role
The Communication & Customer Relations Officer will serve as one of the primary communication representatives of Zaviyar Trading Company.
The officer will be responsible for handling incoming and outgoing telephone calls, WhatsApp messages, customer inquiries, supplier communications, and business-related correspondence.
The position requires a person with excellent communication skills, a pleasant and persuasive speaking style, a polite attitude, and the ability to convince customers professionally.
The officer will communicate with retailers, wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, suppliers, and potential business partners to introduce Zaviyar's services and products, generate customer interest, follow up on inquiries, and support sales activities.
The officer must ensure that every customer receives a professional, friendly, respectful, and timely response, helping Zaviyar build trust and long-term business relationships.
Key Responsibilities & Duties
A. Telephone Communication & Call Handling
· Handle incoming and outgoing company telephone calls professionally.
· Respond to customer calls with a polite, friendly, and confident speaking style.
· Introduce Zaviyar Trading Company and explain its business services.
· Communicate with retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and potential customers.
· Make follow-up calls to customers who have shown interest in Zaviyar's products or services.
· Contact potential customers to introduce new products and business opportunities.
· Explain product availability, prices, offers, and delivery arrangements based on approved company information.
· Transfer technical, financial, or operational inquiries to the relevant department.
· Maintain records of important calls, customer requests, and follow-up requirements.
B. WhatsApp & Digital Customer Communication
· Manage the company's official WhatsApp Business account.
· Respond to customer messages promptly and professionally.
· Answer questions about products, prices, availability, orders, and delivery.
· Share approved product catalogues, pictures, price lists, promotional materials, and company information.
· Follow up with customers who have requested information or product quotations.
· Communicate new product introductions and approved promotional offers.
· Maintain organized customer conversations and follow-up records.
· Ensure that no customer inquiry remains unanswered without proper follow-up.
· Escalate complaints and complicated issues to the responsible department.
C. Customer Relationship Management
· Build and maintain positive relationships with retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and other customers.
· Welcome new customers and explain how to purchase products through Zaviyar.
· Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products from the company's available catalogue.
· Maintain a professional and respectful relationship with existing customers.
· Follow up on customer satisfaction after orders and deliveries.
· Collect customer feedback, suggestions, and complaints.
· Maintain updated customer contact details and communication histories.
· Identify customers who may have potential for regular or bulk purchases.
D. Sales Communication & Customer Conversion
· Use persuasive, professional, and customer-friendly communication to generate interest in Zaviyar's products and services.
· Introduce new products to potential customers through calls and WhatsApp.
· Explain product benefits, approved prices, quality information, and purchasing arrangements.
· Encourage interested customers to place orders.
· Follow up on quotations, pending orders, and customers who have not completed their purchases.
· Identify sales opportunities and refer qualified leads to the Sales Manager or Order Booker team.
· Support sales campaigns and new product launches.
· Maintain records of interested customers, converted customers, and unsuccessful sales inquiries.
· Work toward assigned communication and sales-support targets.
E. Customer Orders & Coordination
· Receive customer order inquiries through telephone and WhatsApp.
· Record customer requirements accurately and forward orders to the relevant sales or order-processing team.
· Confirm that customers receive proper information about order status and delivery arrangements.
· Coordinate with Order Bookers, Sales Representatives, Warehouse, and Logistics teams.
· Follow up on pending orders, delivery delays, and customer requests.
· Inform customers about order updates using verified information from the relevant department.
· Never independently promise unapproved discounts, credit, delivery dates, or special arrangements.
F. Complaint Handling & Customer Support
· Receive and record customer complaints professionally.
· Listen carefully and respond calmly, respectfully, and helpfully.
· Coordinate with the relevant department to resolve customer issues.
· Follow up until the customer receives an appropriate response.
· Maintain a complaint register showing the issue, date, responsible department, and resolution status.
· Inform management about repeated complaints and common customer concerns.
· Protect customer information and maintain confidentiality.
G. Internal Communication & Reporting
· Coordinate with Sales, Finance, Procurement, Warehouse, Logistics, and Management.
· Share customer inquiries and important feedback with the appropriate departments.
· Maintain daily records of calls, WhatsApp messages, inquiries, leads, and follow-ups.
· Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly communication reports.
· Maintain an organized customer contact database.
· Ensure that company communication is consistent, accurate, and professional.
H. Delegated Responsibilities
· Perform other relevant duties assigned by the line manager in accordance with the position's responsibilities and company requirements.
Work Environment & Conditions
A. Office Setup
The officer will work at Zaviyar Trading Company's head office in Kabul, using company communication facilities, telephone services, WhatsApp Business, and customer management systems.
B. Working Hours
Saturday to Thursday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, subject to company policy and applicable labor requirements.
C. Coordination
The officer will report to the designated line manager and work closely with the Sales and Customer Relations teams.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be assessed based on:
· Number of incoming and outgoing calls handled.
· Response time to WhatsApp and other customer inquiries.
· Quality and professionalism of communication.
· Number of potential customers contacted.
· Number of qualified sales leads generated.
· Number of customers successfully converted into buyers.
· Accuracy of customer records and follow-up information.

title: Data Clerk
description:
Job Summary
Purpose of the Post:
To ensure accurate collection and management of Polio Eradication Initiative (PEI & EPI) data in the province
Organizational context :
Under the direct supervision of the ARPO/our client Regional Team Lead/Medical Officer Polio and the overall supervision of the our client Representative in Afghanistan.

Job Requirements
Summary of Assigned Duties:
The incumbent will perform the following duties:
Working under direct supervision of the respective Provincial Polio Officer, the incumbent will work in close coordination with the Provincial PEI Manager; the incumbent data clerk will undertake the following duties:
1. Compile all data related to supplementary immunization activities including pre-, intra-, and post-campaign activities.
2. Compile the administrative (reported) coverage and intra-campaign monitoring data of all supplementary immunization activities (OPV and OPV/IPV).
3. Compile and feed forward polio surveillance related data.
4. Validate and clean all the compiled data; and maintain repository of the provincial data.
5. Feed forwards the validated data to the regional and provincial levels as per the program timelines.
6. Any other as assigned by the supervisor.

1. A national of Afghanistan
2. Diploma/Degree in Computer Science/IT
3. Minimum 2 years of relevant data management experience.
4. Experience in international agencies is an asset.
5. Good working knowledge of English and local languages.
6. Resident of the area of assignment or proven affiliation/familiarity with it.
7. Ability to work harmoniously as a member of a team and adapt to diverse social and cultural backgrounds.
8. Maintain high standards of personal conduct and integrity.
9. Willingness to work long hours and weekends, especially during important activities such conferences/meetings, vaccination campaigns, and other essential events.
Competencies:
1. Fostering Integration and Teamwork
2. Communicating in a credible and effective way
3. Knowing and managing your self
Functional Skills and Knowledge:
1. The candidate should have at least two years of working experience with data entrance.

3. Should be able to speak Dari, Pashto, and Basic English.
4. Should be able to work during the campaigns until late hours.
5. Should be able to work independently and in a team.

• Compile and presents technical/ operational reports for superiors as required.
• Maintain close interfaces with the Network Quality section.
• Provide support in proposing changes and modifications of procedures to optimize equipment utilization, labor, and resources to achieve higher reliability as well as efficiency.

• Fiber Optic Network Planning and design
• Transmission dimensioning for LTE Sites
• TX optimization, optimize the current MW B.B and backhauling
• Ensure all projects are delivered within time, budget, and with strict adherence to quality and safety standards

The Software Product Owner will work under the overall guidance of the Chief Executive Officer and under the direct supervision of the Product Manager. This role is responsible for defining the product vision, managing the product backlog, and ensuring that the final output aligns with both business goals and user needs. The Product Owner acts as a key liaison between stakeholders and the development team, translating strategic objectives into actionable tasks. The individual must possess strong communication skills, business acumen, and a user-focused mindset to guide the product throughout its development lifecycle and deliver maximum value to the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and Manage the Product Backlog :
Define and prioritize features, user stories, and tasks for the development team.
Ensure the product backlog is updated and transparent to the team.
Engage with Stakeholders :
Collaborate with customers, users, and stakeholders to gather product requirements.
Communicate effectively with the development team to ensure a clear understanding of business and technical needs.
Define Product Vision :
Establish and communicate the product's vision, goals, and strategy to the development team and stakeholders.
Align the product with market needs in collaboration with the Product Manager.
Make Decisions on Product Features and Functionality :
Decide which features to prioritize and which to de-prioritize.
Provide feedback to the development team on design and functionality.
Evaluate and Test the Product :
Participate in product testing and provide relevant feedback to the development team.
Ensure the final product meets the requirements and expectations of stakeholders.

Manage changes in priorities and adjust plans as needed.

Manage Stakeholder and Customer Expectations :
Ensure customer satisfaction by delivering a product that meets their needs and resolves their problems.

Ensure the product is release-ready and meets quality standards.

The performance of the Product Owner has a direct impact on the success of product development and overall business growth. title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
description:
Job Summary
Ramaki Group of Companies is seeking a qualified Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to define and execute the technology vision, strategy, and roadmap for its digital products and platforms. The role focuses on strategic leadership, secure and scalable infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and building a high-performing engineering team, all aligned with organizational business goals, customer needs, and industry standards.
The CTO will own the end-to-end technology function for Ramaki's fintech operations, from strategic planning and team development to vendor management and system reliability. The role combines strategic decision-making, cybersecurity oversight, regulatory and risk support, innovation, and cross-functional collaboration with the CEO, board, and compliance teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Leadership and Decision-Making
• Define the technology vision, strategy, and roadmap in line with business goals.
• Work with the CEO and executive team on product, growth, and investment decisions.
• Lead, hire, and develop the engineering team across backend, frontend, mobile and UI/UX.
• Report on technology progress, risks, and budget to the board and investors.
Cybersecurity and Infrastructure
• Oversee the security approach and make sure security is built into the platform.
• Ensure infrastructure, customer data protection, backup, and disaster recovery meet business needs and payment security standards such as PCI DSS.
Regulatory, Risk and Compliance Support
• Work with Compliance and Risk teams so systems support EMI requirements such as safeguarding, KYC/AML and transaction monitoring.
• Support audits and regulator or partner reviews on technical matters.
Technology Innovation and Vendor Management
• Select and manage technology vendors and partners, such as payment processors, card providers, banking partners and KYC providers, and own the technology budget.
• Evaluate new technologies that improve efficiency, security or customer experience.

title: IT Database Administrator
description:
Role Summary
This role responsible for administering, maintaining, and securing Oracle database environments to ensure high availability, optimal performance, and reliability. Key responsibilities include database administration, PL/SQL development, performance tuning, backup and recovery, security management, and implementing HA/DR solutions using RMAN, RAC, ASM, and Data Guard, while ensuring efficient operations and 24/7 technical support.

Duties and Responsibilities
Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain Oracle Database software and related components.
Manage, administer, and monitor Oracle databases to ensure high availability, security, reliability, and optimal performance.
Build and maintain new databases and development, testing, UAT, and production environments.
Develop and maintain PL/SQL procedures, functions, packages, and triggers, and perform SQL and database performance tuning.
Design, implement, and maintain database architecture, structures, and schemas.
Design and manage database backup and recovery solutions using Oracle RMAN.
Implement and maintain Oracle High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions, including RAC, ASM, and Data Guard.
Perform database space management, partitioning, capacity planning, replication, and recovery operations.
Implement, maintain database security, access controls, auditing, and compliance requirements.
Automate database administration and maintenance tasks using shell scripting and Oracle tools.
Perform database migrations, patch management, version control, upgrades, and production schema changes.
Diagnose, resolve database performance, connectivity, availability, infrastructure-related issues.
Monitor database capacity, resource utilization, performance to ensure optimal efficiency and scalability.
Maintain database documentation, technical standards, operational procedures, and performance reports.
Evaluate Oracle technology, product to improve database infrastructure and operational efficiency.
Work closely with the Head of Section, infrastructure teams, database programmers, and application developers.
Coordinate with Oracle Corporation, relevant vendors for technical support and issue resolution.
Provide technical guidance and training to team members and participate in on-call duties to ensure 24/7 database support when required.
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.
Familiarity with Linux and Oracle Solaris operating systems, including system administration, command-line operations, shell scripting, and troubleshooting.

Job Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of five (5) years of professional experience in database administration, preferably with enterprise-level Oracle Database environments.
Oracle Certified Associate (OCA) certification and Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) certification would be a plus point.
Strong knowledge and practical experience with Oracle Grid Infrastructure, Automatic Storage Management (ASM), and Real Application Clusters (RAC).
Strong knowledge of Oracle Data Guard, RMAN, backup and recovery, and high availability technologies.
Solid understanding of Oracle database architecture, internals, and performance tuning.
Experience with Oracle database installation, patching, upgrades, and migrations.
SQL and PL/SQL Development, Database Design, and Performance Tuning.
Database Security, Auditing, Capacity Planning, and Space Management.
Database Automation and Shell Scripting (Bash/Korn Shell).
Database Replication, Migration, Monitoring, and Troubleshooting.

Submission Guidelines
If you meet the above requirements, we are encouraging you to apply for this position. Please send us your CV along with a cover letter via email ( vacancies@fmfb.com.af ).
Please make sure that your email includes the vacancy ID as the subject line.

About Doximity
Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.
At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.
About the Role
As a Business Intelligence Analyst , you will:
Work closely with our Product, Strategic Analytics, Client Success, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.
Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates.
Continue to improve your technical and non-technical skill sets.
Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.
Grow into a presentation/communication-focused role or dive deeper into more-involved technical challenges—the choice is yours.
What We're Looking For

Three (3) years of experience illustrating collaboration, passion for data, reliability, precision, curiosity, and respect for teammates and clients.
Excellent SQL skills with proven ability to create and evaluate complex SQL statements involving numerous tables and complex relationships.
Fluent in Python and experience using common modules (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib) for EDA.
Experience collaborating with non-technical stakeholders.
Nice to have:
Working knowledge of statistics and visualization.
Experience working with data visualization tools.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience using AI coding assistants and building AI-leveraged workflows.
Experience working in the healthcare industry.
Experience presenting data to a non-technical audience.
The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team
As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.
Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.
Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.
Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.
Precision – Our team's deliverables power client analysis and inform real-world decisions. A successful candidate will triple check their work and their teammates' work, holding all of us to the highest data quality standards.
Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.
Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.
Why You'll Love Working Here

Prepared Date: 10/1/26
